implementation: Refine the existing FieldRegistry and FieldAssociation. One logical registered value owner receives the association; ambiguous controls receive none. Ownership transfers release the previous Field before applying the next one.

Association returns owned semantic defaults rather than writing over the semantic controller. Public slot elements provide native references; scoped text mirrors handle the remaining text/reference boundary.

Native form context excludes a Field-disabled control from submission and active validation without rewriting its own disabled setting or losing its current value. Root groups propagate effective disability through their existing member protocol.
Native input/select/textarea adapters retain authored descriptions, native validation and their own disabled intent, including same-task changes before clearing Field disability.
required/optional are mutually exclusive label presentation; control required/native validity remains explicit. invalid adds presentation and an error description without inventing native invalidity.
Field consumes one group root, preserving option labels. Selection cards retain their own descriptions alongside Field help/errors.
limits: Generated React reconciliation/adapter acceptance remains M22.
Structural native-control attribute changes settle through their observers; Field property changes and control submission synchronization are immediate.
Actual speech output and final library-wide acceptance remain M26.

fixtures.source: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH='/var/folders/b6/2r9mrtsj70s3x013xbhxt2yr0000gn/T/acme-style-engines-fHTyxk/browsers';const pw=await import('/var/folders/b6/2r9mrtsj70s3x013xbhxt2yr0000gn/T/acme-style-engines-fHTyxk/package/index.mjs');const results=[];for(const engine of ['chromium','firefox','webkit']){const browser=await pw[engine].launch(engine==='chromium'?{headless:true,executablePath:'/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome'}:{headless:true});try{const page=await browser.newPage();const errors=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4180/components/field');const form=page.locator('#field-form-example');await form.locator('acme-button[type=submit]').click();const invalid=await form.evaluate(el=>el.querySelector('acme-field').invalid&&!el.checkValidity());await form.locator('select').selectOption('ca');await form.locator('acme-button[type=submit]').click();const submitted=await form.locator('output').textContent()==='ca';await form.locator('acme-button[type=reset]').click();const reset=await form.evaluate(el=>!el.querySelector('acme-field').invalid&&el.querySelector('select').value==='');await page.locator('#field-radio-example [slot=label]').click();const focus=await page.locator('#field-radio-example').evaluate(el=>{const radio=el.querySelector('acme-radio');return radio.shadowRoot.activeElement===radio.shadowRoot.querySelector('input');});results.push({engine,invalid,submitted,reset,focus,errors});console.log(results.at(-1));}finally{await browser.close();}}await Bun.write('/tmp/acme-m11-field/docs-results.json',JSON.stringify(results,null,2)+'\n');if(results.some(r=>!r.invalid||!r.submitted||!r.reset||!r.focus||r.errors.length))process.exitCode=1;
